messages:
maya: Hey everyone — Hosted API is GA as of today. Major callouts: streaming responses, tool-calling/function-style calls, and three new model variants (rwd-large, rwd-compact-int4, rwd-multiling). Docs and SDKs are updated; default model for new accounts will be rwd-large. Please read the migration notes before switching existing apps. :tada:

dan: Amazing news, congrats all! Quick Q: any immediate quota/rate-limit changes customers should expect?
maya: No default quota changes. Enterprise/dedicated customers can opt into reserved capacity. We added a new per-route throttle setting in the console for power users.
sophie: I'll push an update to the quickstart guides and add a "what's new" migration doc highlighting streaming vs non-streaming usage. Tagging infra if there are example curl snippets that need changing.
alex: Streaming now uses SSE with token-chunks + a metadata line for function-calls. Heads up: Python SDK streaming helper method name changes from `.streaming()` -> `.stream()` (tiny patch queued). Non-streaming usage is fully backwards compatible.
deploy-bot: deploy status: hosted-api/production - release/hosted-ga (commit a1b2c3d) succeeded in 3 regions (us-west1, eu-west1, asia-east1).
julian: Monitoring: new dashboards for streaming token latency and function-call error rates. I'm setting an alert for error_rate > 0.5% over 5m. If you see spikes, @julian on-call.
samir: Do we have a customer-facing one-pager or bullet list I can send to early adopters?
marketing-bot: Shared: https://intranet.redwood.ai/announcements/hosted-ga-one-pager — contains feature bullets, example prompts, and pricing FAQ.
maya: Thanks — marketing one-pager looks great. Also: v1 compatibility will be maintained for 90 days; after that we'll start deprecating old endpoints (advance notice will be sent). If your integration samples reference v1, please plan a small update.
dan: Noted. Any infra caveats for plugin/tool-calling integrations? Latency-sensitive apps should pin to dedicated pools?
alex: Yes — for < 50ms p95 you should use Dedicated or pin to low-latency regions. We added an autoscaling safety cap to avoid noisy-neighbor bursts; file an SRE runbook if you need exceptions.
sophie: I'll add a short migration checklist to the docs with sample curl/snippets (incl. streaming examples).
maya: Huge thanks to everyone — incredible cross-team work. We'll do a quick synced celebration at 1pm in the kitchen (cake!) and a deeper postmortem doc in #product within 24h with usage guidance and known issues. Please flag anything urgent in this thread. :rocket:
